notes: POWO and Flora of North America recognize Euphorbia heterophylla as accepted.
Older literature may use Poinsettia heterophylla.

target_zone_range_leads.guardrail: Do not assign project-native status from state occurrence. Deep Review must resolve native-versus-introduced evidence and exact counties.
leads: Master Plant Pool records 4 personal wild observations.
POWO lists Texas as introduced rather than native.
FNA treats the species as introduced/naturalized in Texas and notes uncertainty around its broader tropical native range.
This may still be valuable as a locally encountered comparison species even if it fails the native threshold.

morphology_candidate.look_here_first: Inspect the upper bracts and the cyathial gland. E. heterophylla usually keeps its floral bracts green or only pale at the base and has a stipitate gland with a circular opening and an annular rim.
diagnostic_traits: annual herb with highly polymorphic leaves
leaves can be lanceolate, elliptic, broad-obovate, pandurate, or lobed
upper floral bracts green or only paler at base rather than sharply red/pink/orange
gland opening circular with annular rim
capsules broadly ovoid and usually glabrous

confusers.separator: E. cyathophora usually has strongly colored upper-bract bases and an oblong gland opening lacking an annular rim; E. heterophylla has green/pale bracts and a circular-rimmed gland.

photo_candidates.source: A. Sergeev photo archive, Texas A&M Holistic Garden
photo_candidates.creator: A. Sergeev

diagnostic_image_needs: circular gland opening with annular rim

user_photo_review.note: User reviewed the Euphorbia contact sheet and approved all displayed current candidates. Preserve any existing diagnostic-photo-gap notes so later photo polish can still add stronger structure-specific images.

taxonomy.notes: POWO and Flora of North America accept E. heterophylla; Poinsettia heterophylla is an important synonym.

evidence_basis: POWO lists Texas in the introduced range, not the native range.
Flora of North America treats Texas occurrence as introduced/naturalized and notes that the precise tropical/subtropical native range is uncertain.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not count this taxon in native project metrics; retain only as a locally encountered comparison taxon.

morphology.look_here_first: Green or merely pale upper bracts plus a stipitate cyathial gland with a circular opening and annular rim.
morphology.key_separator: E. cyathophora usually has sharply colored bract bases and an oblong gland opening lacking an annular rim.

photo_review.note: Current approved candidate is adequate for private study; gland-macro and direct E. cyathophora comparison remain desirable.

deep_review.next_action: Await user approval for comparison-only curation; exclude from native metrics.
